text: L'Auxiliaire is a mutual insurance company for building and public-works professionals ('mutuelle d'assurance des professionnels du bâtiment et des travaux publics'), a mutualist firm governed by a board made up exclusively of BTP company executives, based in Lyon.
short: L'Auxiliaire is a mutual insurer for BTP professionals governed by its member companies' executives.

source.name: L'Auxiliaire: 'L'Auxiliaire renforce son engagement aux côtés de LDLC ASVEL' (press release)
source.quote: Acteur mutualiste gouverné par un Conseil d'Administration composé exclusivement de chefs d'entreprises du BTP
